::: {.about-text}

Hi, I'm Shusuke Ioku, a Ph.D. candidate in Political Science at the University of Rochester. I work on the political economy of conflict, broadly construed. Topics I currently study include state development, interstate conflict, and information operations. I approach them with formal theory and micro-level historical data. You can find my current projects on the [research page](research.qmd).
